name: Seeed XIAO ePaper 7.5" (S3, mono)
description: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus driver board plus a 7.5 inch monochrome ePaper panel (800x480), sold as the TRMNL 7.5" (OG) DIY Kit. Not the integrated XIAO 7.5" ePaper Panel (C3), which is a separate product around the same glass, see xiao_epaper_panel_75_c3. Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API and paints a raw 1-bpp mono buffer (48000 bytes) produced by the esp32_bw_bin renderer. Byte-identical wire contract to the Seeed reTerminal E1001; the two panels are cross-compatible on the frame side. Battery state is reported as unknown for now, sense pin not wired in the reference board.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware. Wire format is exactly 48000 bytes (800*480/8), MSB=leftmost pixel, bit-set=white, bit-clear=black; no header, no padding, no checksum. Frame is byte-identical to the seeed_reterminal_e1001 target, so validate cross-panel by pointing the same renderer output at both. Renderer keeps normal top-left orientation; the firmware handles any physical panel-side mirror itself.
